conf.description: Workspace ONE UEM device events, syslog-kv: admin-authored Message Content template (key=value pairs), filtered to EventType=Device, mapped to ECS. Per recommendations.direct.cribl, EventData is length-capped here (no vendor cap given, 2048 chars chosen) since the direct recommendation retains that requirement even without a guard crossing.

conf.comment: device-events/syslog-kv. Template is admin-authored, not vendor-fixed - pin in change control per the catalog. EventType routes Device vs Console; this pipeline keeps Device only (console-events pipeline keeps Console). Device/FriendlyName coalesced into host.name (template uses one or the other). DeviceUdid feeds both device.id and host.id. EventCategory->ECS category and outcome-from-suffix are inline enum lookups (small closed vendor enum, no external table available). EventTimestamp has no UTC offset in the template (e.g. 'May 21, 2025 13:53:26'); Date.parse is best-effort local-time - see README gap. EventData capped at 2048 chars.

functions.description: pipeline purpose, routing key, and documented gaps
extract the admin-authored key=value Message Content fields
this pipeline serves device-events only; Console records belong to the console-events pipeline on the same syslog listener
map every field to its ECS/custom target, derive outcome/category, cap EventData, remove raw duplicates
rename the remaining strictly 1:1 mapped fields (event.action/device.id/host.id already set via eval above and removed from this batch to avoid ordering conflicts)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
